races.paceDynamic: Layla Liz and Ruby's Profit will engage from the start, with both natural front runners likely to dispute the early lead in this 16-runner handicap. Their clash should create an honest gallop throughout, preventing any pedestrian fractions that could benefit late closers. With prominent runners like Equality, Master Of My Fate, Lexington Blitz, and Rhythm N Hooves tracking the pace, the tempo will be maintained but not suicidal. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early pace pressers who can position close enough to strike when the front runners tire in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Duel Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Layla Liz and Ruby's Profit engage in a sustained battle from the off
scenarios.body: The fierce early pace will set up the race perfectly for prominent runners tracking just behind. Those positioned within 3-4 lengths can time their challenges to perfection as the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If one front runner establishes a clear advantage without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and potentially stay on strongly. Hold-up horses get their preferred scenario but face the challenge of making up significant ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners make their moves approaching the 2f pole rather than waiting
scenarios.body: The sudden injection of pace catches hold-up horses flat-footed and creates a sprint finish between those positioned handy. Early pace becomes less crucial as the race develops its own momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages of the race
scenarios.body: A stop-start tempo creates chaos with no clear tactical advantage for any running style. The winner emerges from pure class or a perfectly timed late surge rather than positional advantage.

The Cowell pair Lexington Blitz and Rhythm N Hooves could work in tandem to control the prominent positions

races.paceDynamic: Benvenuto Cellini, Balzac, Menzies, and A Taste Of Glory will ensure a fierce early gallop from the start. This quartet of confirmed front-runners guarantees strong sectionals throughout, with the relentless Epsom downhill gradient adding further pressure. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations over this extended 1m2f trip. This aggressive pace dynamic clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina reserves, penalising those dependent on controlled gallops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the four pace-setters maintain their aggressive tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Wise Prince and Shayem possess the class and finishing kick to capitalise on this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Control Late
scenarios.trigger: If Action and Shabab Al Ahli track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: These classy prominent racers can position perfectly behind the speed duel before launching sustained drives. Their tactical speed and stamina blend suits this intermediate scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast and falter dramatically before the turn
scenarios.body: Mid-division horses like Spyce and New Zealand can inherit a more manageable tempo and kick clear. The race becomes more tactical, suiting those with tactical pace rather than pure finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire To Wire Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Benvenuto Cellini or A Taste Of Glory establish clear leads and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters proves their stamina superiority and repels all challengers. This requires exceptional stamina reserves and perfect tactical execution from their jockeys.

watchPoints.text: Benvenuto Cellini and A Taste Of Glory could set suicidal fractions if they engage in an early speed duel

races.paceDynamic: Alcarath, Atherstone Warrior and Fierce Fortitude will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this stamina-testing trip. The presence of multiple confirmed pace-setters in a 22-runner handicap will create an honest tempo that should suit those with tactical speed rather than pure early pace. The combination of Epsom's undulating track and the sustained gallop will expose any lack of stamina, making this a race that strongly favours prominent racers and patient hold-up horses who can finish strongly when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners (Alcarath, Atherstone Warrior, Fierce Fortitude) go forward and sustain a strong pace
scenarios.body: The honest tempo will set up perfectly for horses with finishing kicks who can sit handy or come from behind. Patient tactics will be rewarded as the pace-setters tie up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners (likely Alcarath) takes a clear lead while others sit closer
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with a moderate pace that could suit those prominent racers with tactical speed. The finish becomes more about class and finishing kick from a reasonable position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in early speed duels and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The excessive early pace will leave the door open for the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. This scenario most benefits those held up furthest back with proven finishing ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Fierce Fortitude or Alcarath establishes an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The pace-setter could dictate terms and prove hard to peg back if allowed easy fractions. Only the classiest closers would have a chance of reeling in a controlled front-running performance.

races.paceDynamic: Atherstone Warrior, Antrim, Topteam, Square Necker and Fierce Fortitude will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this competitive handicap. With five confirmed front-runners in an 18-runner field, the pace will be searching and honest throughout, particularly testing given Epsom's unique undulations over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip. The leaders will set up the race for those with tactical pace who can position prominently or for strong stayers who can produce sustained finishes. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with proven stamina - the pure speed horses will find this too far at this searching gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the five front-runners maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for hold-up horses with proven stamina who can produce telling finishes up Epsom's demanding hill. Sing Us A Song and Master Builder represent the profile that thrives when early pace is strong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Control
scenarios.trigger: If Night Breeze or Asgard's Captain can settle just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: These tactical speedsters can avoid the early burn-up while staying close enough to strike when the front-runners weaken on the climb. Their class and race-fitness gives them the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Topteam can dominate from the front with tactical riding from Murphy
scenarios.body: His recent Lingfield success shows he can handle pressure when things fall right, and the strong pace could actually suit if he can dictate terms. Atherstone Warrior also has the class to lead and stay.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early allowing speed to dominate
scenarios.body: Analogical and Kimeko Glory carry significant weight advantages and could exploit any tactical errors up front. This requires the front five to go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically.

races.paceDynamic: Pureis King will take this forward from the start but his poor recent form and tendency to fade suggests he won't sustain the gallop for long. Domenico Contarini, Princling and Exquisite Skye are the main prominent racers who will track the early pace, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Knights Charge, Fizzy Bear, Nuptown Girl and Hengest will be looking for strong finishing kicks. With only one weak front-runner against multiple prominent racers and many closers, this sets up as a tactical affair that will likely develop into a sprint finish. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with finishing kicks, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate with Pureis King setting a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent racers will get first run but tire in the final furlong, allowing the fresh closers to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Knights Charge and Nuptown Girl are perfectly positioned to benefit from this unfolding.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Control
scenarios.trigger: If Domenico Contarini and Princling press Pureis King early to ensure a true gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will stretch out the field and prevent the hold-up horses from mounting their usual late charges. Exquisite Skye and Domenico Contarini can then use their class advantage in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomers Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the three debutants Champion Lawman, Hattie's Comet or Turret show significant improvement from their homework
scenarios.body: The established form horses will be caught napping by a well-handicapped newcomer with untapped potential. The strong trainer records of Johnston, Boyle and Balding suggest hidden ability waiting to be unleashed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the jockeys get their timing wrong in the moderate early pace and bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with horses getting checked and having to switch for runs in the final two furlongs. Lower-rated horses like Get Outta Here and Sir Griflet could sneak through on the rails while the fancied runners get trapped.

watchPoints.text: Pureis King setting too slow a pace early which will play directly into the hands of all the hold-up horses behind him
The three debutants Champion Lawman, Hattie's Comet and Turret in the betting ring for market support indicating readiness
Knights Charge and Nuptown Girl getting good positions in the first half of the race to launch their finishing kicks
Domenico Contarini and Princling tracking too close to the pace and using up their energy before the final furlong
The Dylan Cunha pair Hengest and Sir Griflet working in tandem to help each other's chances in the home straight

races.paceDynamic: On Message and Assaranca will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both having confirmed front-running tendencies and the tactical speed to establish position early. The honest pace they create over this stamina-testing trip will stretch the field and expose any lack of fitness in the returning brigade. With multiple hold-up horses including Delinquent, Chapter, and Royal Bodyguard needing the race to fall apart late, the sustained gallop will favour those who can travel prominently and have something left for the finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can avoid getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If On Message and Assaranca maintain their duel into the straight without folding
scenarios.body: The relentless pace prevents the hold-up brigade from mounting their usual late charges, allowing prominent travellers to dominate the finish. Those who positioned themselves handily behind the leaders capitalise when the pace-setters inevitably weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners crack simultaneously in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the strongest stayers with the best turn of foot prevail from off the pace. Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario as the early gallop sets up perfectly for late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with neither leader able to dominate
scenarios.body: The race develops into a messy affair where positioning and jockey tactics become crucial rather than pure pace analysis. Those drawn well with experienced pilots gain significant advantages in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If On Message or Assaranca gets an easy lead with the other failing to go forward
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls the race completely, potentially stealing a march on the field if the pace becomes too conservative. Front-runners get their dream scenario with no early pressure.

watchPoints.text: On Message and Assaranca must both go forward early or the pace scenario changes completely
Multiple long-absent runners including Royal Bodyguard and Runswick may need the outing badly

races.paceDynamic: Bubbles Wonky is the sole confirmed front-runner and will control this race from the start, with no early pressure allowing her to dictate comfortable fractions. Sweet Reward, Jimmy Speaking, Hot Cash, It'sneverjustone, Silver Trumpet and Amused will track in the prominent positions behind the leader. The large field of hold-up horses including El Matador, Mr Baloo, Principality, Knights Gold and Shafdar will need to navigate traffic problems in the back half. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and pounce, avoiding the inevitable traffic issues that will plague the back-markers around Epsom's unique bends.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bubbles Wonky sets steady fractions and prominent trackers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows horses like Sweet Reward, Jimmy Speaking and It'sneverjustone to position perfectly and strike with decisive moves. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind the large midfield pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses fail to capitalize and gaps open late
scenarios.body: Quality hold-up performers like El Matador, Mr Baloo or Shafdar find clear passage and unleash superior finishing speed. Their class tells in the final furlong despite tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Hangs On
scenarios.trigger: If Bubbles Wonky gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds enough advantage to resist late challers, with her 12lb weight advantage proving decisive. Prominent horses lack the pace to reel her in after tracking too conservatively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Bubbles Wonky goes too slow and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a messy bunch finish where any horse can win with luck in running. Light-weighted outsiders like Amused or Tronido could sneak through.
